  {"step":2,"file":"bin/fribidi-fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":28,"var":"str","code":"FriBidiChar *str = (FriBidiChar *) data;","note":"The raw input buffer is cast directly to Unicode code points and passed into FriBidi."},
  {"step":3,"file":"bin/fribidi-fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":33,"var":"types,btypes,levels","code":"calloc (str_len, sizeof (...))","note":"The fuzzer allocates parallel output arrays sized to the derived character count."},
  {"step":4,"file":"bin/fribidi-fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":34,"var":"types","code":"fribidi_get_bidi_types (str, str_len, types);","note":"FriBidi classifies the attacker-controlled code points into bidi types that drive later run construction."},
  {"step":5,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"fribidi_get_par_embedding_levels_ex","line":531,"var":"main_run_list","code":"main_run_list = run_list_encode_bidi_types (bidi_types, bracket_types, len);","note":"The bidi types are encoded into a linked list of runs, preserving adjacency and isolate links."},
  {"step":6,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"fribidi_get_par_embedding_levels_ex","line":840,"var":"main_run_list","code":"compact_list (main_run_list);","note":"Adjacent runs with the same type and level are merged, which can free a run node while iterating."},
  {"step":7,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"compact_list","line":100,"var":"list","code":"if (RL_TYPE (list->prev) == RL_TYPE (list) && RL_LEVEL (list->prev) == RL_LEVEL (list) ... ) list = merge_with_prev (list);","note":"A merge is triggered when attacker-controlled input creates adjacent compatible runs."},
  {"step":8,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"merge_with_prev","line":79,"var":"second","code":"fribidi_free (second);","note":"The current run node is freed after its neighbors are relinked."},
  {"step":9,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"merge_with_prev","line":73,"var":"second->next->prev_isolate","code":"else if (second->next->prev_isolate == second) second->next->prev_isolate = second->prev_isolate;","note":"The bug is a stale pointer update: the code writes through a node that may already have been freed or reused during list compaction, producing a heap-use-after-free write."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
